"""One source-bound execution of the prospectively frozen fitter."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root/'bench'))
import two_fe_policy_gates as gates

head = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True).strip()
assert head.startswith('ca090b06'), head
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1'], text=True)
review_path = Path('bench/results/two-fe-policy-revision-review-20261022.json')
review = json.loads(review_path.read_bytes())
for name, expected in review['frozen_sources'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
output = Path('bench/results/two-fe-policy-gates-fit-20261022.json')
assert not output.exists(), 'never overwrite a fitted candidate'
print('Frozen source verified; reconstructing all 1728 retained calls.', flush=True)
data = gates.collect(root)
print('Reconstruction passed: 108 contexts, 72 same-action32, 84 absent cells. Starting the single fit.', flush=True)
fit = gates.fit(data['contexts'], total_cells=data['total_cells'])
record = dict(schema='two-fe-policy-gates-fit-v1', freeze_head=head,
    review_record=dict(file=str(review_path), sha256=hashlib.sha256(review_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),
    frozen_sources=review['frozen_sources'],
    driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
    driver_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    real_selection_runs=1, new_native_calls=0, held_out_observations=0,
    historical_calls_validated=data['native_calls'], bindings=data['bindings'],
    no_episode=data['no_episode'], unavailable_installations=data['unavailable'],
    limits=data['limits'], result=fit)
encoded = json.dumps(gates.json_value(record), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
assert len(encoded.encode()) < 1000000
with output.open('x') as stream:
    stream.write(encoded)
print(json.dumps(gates.json_value({k: fit[k] for k in ('gates','candidate_gates','pairs_evaluated','costs','coverage','observation_footprint')}), indent=2), flush=True)
print(json.dumps(dict(output=str(output), bytes=output.stat().st_size, sha256=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest())), flush=True)
